study type: Animal model study (Pde6brd10 mouse model of retinitis pigmentosa) with in vitro experiments.
exposure: Intravitreal injection of poly (lactic-co-glycolic) acid microspheres (PLGA-MS) loaded with methionylated human recombinant proinsulin (hPI)
outcome: Outer nuclear layer (ONL) cellular preservation (thickness and number of cell rows)
TUNEL assay for photoreceptor cell death
cohort: The participants were Pde6brd10 mice, a genetic model for retinitis pigmentosa.
finding: A single intravitreal injection of human recombinant proinsulin-loaded microspheres significantly increased electroretinographic b-wave amplitudes and attenuated photoreceptor cell loss, thereby slowing retinal degeneration in the rd10 mouse.
followup_time: Approximately 10-11 days (injections on P14-P15, assessment at P25).
